protocol.scope: 4 previously observed failed pairs, 8 clips: development-only feasibility trial
protocol.comparison: Two videos in the same context; new comparison instructions; this changes context and prompt together, not a single-factor ablation
protocol.order_check: AB and BA; every dimension must agree after canonical video mapping. Uncertain, disagreements, invalid output and weighted ties abstain.
protocol.early_stop: Stop after first pair if neither order gives a valid final comparison; retain both raw outputs
metrics: correct over all 4 planned pairs; abstentions are not correct
accuracy among selected pairs with denominator shown
protocol.decision: No automatic promotion. Fresh prompts and regression cases must be tested before integration; development gains cannot be treated as holdout results.
protocol.labels: Only used after inference for scoring, never included in model messages
